model_annotation: This stacked bar chart illustrates the hectares of an unspecified variable across seven countries from 2013 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the years from 2013 to 2022, labeled in ascending order. The vertical axis on the left represents the quantity in hundreds of hectares, ranging from 0 to 1200 in increments of 200. Each country is represented by a distinct color: Spain (blue), France (orange), China/continental/ (gray), Italy (yellow), Turkey (brown), the USA (green), and Argentina (dark blue). The bars for each year are stacked, with Spain consistently having the tallest stack, approximately 1000 hectares in 2013 and 2022, and Argentina the shortest, approximately 350 and 325, respectively. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
